1 | Q3 marked the continued solid turnaround, revenue growth returned and profitability continued to improve.

Q3 marked a solid turnaround for our business. Our total revenues returned to positive growth and profitability expanded at an accelerating pace compared to last quarter. Core JD Retail delivered solid top and bottom line expansion. Gross margin reached a new record as we relentlessly focused on driving supply chain e ciencies while operating margin held firm against last year's record high base.

2 | JD Retail saw broad-based acceleration across electronics and home appliances, general merchandise and marketplace and marketing.

JD Retail achieved clear operational and nancial improvement in Q3. We saw broad-based acceleration across all major business lines within JD Retail, including electronics and home appliances, general merchandise and marketplace and marketing services. Looking at category performance, top-line momentum of electronics and home appliances rebounded meaningfully compared to the previous quarter.

3 | General merchandise grew 8%, led by faster growth in supermarket, double digit growth in health care and industrial products. Fashion and home goods also saw QoQ improvements.

General merchandise revenues sustained strong momentum, up 8.1% year-on-year to RMB 105 billion. The strong performance of general merchandise was driven by the continued healthy expansion of our supermarket category and the double-digit growth of health care and industrial products. Meanwhile, fashion and home goods also showed sequential improvements. Such broad-based momentum across categories demonstrates that our growth drivers are becoming increasingly diversified and well balanced.

4 | Faster growing and more profitable marketplace and marketing revenues, up 10%, will continue to improve profit margins.

Service revenues were RMB 76 billion, up 4.7% YoY in Q3. Marketplace and the marketing revenues were up 9.6%, primarily driven by double-digit growth in advertising revenues.

Beyond fueling top line growth, the rapid growth of advertising also serves as a structural driver of our margin expansion over tim

5 | JD Retail GPM expanded for 18 consecutive quarters and crossed 20% for the first time.

Our successful execution across categories and platform ecosystem expansion translated directly into robust profitability. JD Retail's gross margin expanded year-on-year for 18 consecutive quarters and crossed the 20% threshold for the first time.

6 | Food delivery continue to be strong while still loss making, profitability continues to improve.

For our food delivery, driving sustained operating efficiency gains and loss reduction remains a strategic imperative. It achieved over 50% year-on-year reduction in operating losses in Q3 while maintaining positive sequential momentum.

7 | Launched Dongdong, an AI shopping assistant is showing strong early traction and measurable lift in user scale, conversion rate, order volume and GMV.

First, on customer demand generation. In September, we launched Dongdong, our next-gen AI shopping assistant. It marks a paradigm shift in our user experience from the traditional keyword search to AI-driven intent-based problem solving. Seamlessly integrated into our main app, Dongdong accurately interprets complex consumer intent and maps them directly to our vast catalog of products and services. Early traction has been strong, delivering measurable lift in user scale, conversion rate, order volume and GMV.

8 | See a clear path to continue growing JD Retail by expanding product categories and brands, offer quality products at good prices to meet demands of different users. Sizeable room in general merchandise, supermarket, and apparels.

Looking ahead, we are seeing a clear path to continued growth for JD Retail. First, we will further strengthen our so-called traditional ecommerce. We'll continue to expand our selection of categories and brands, improve supply chain efficiency to offer quality products at good price and meet the demands of different users. In terms of our electronics and home appliance category, we know that innovation can create demand and create a new line of products and categories. We also have sizable room to gain market shares, especially in general merchandise categories such as supermarket and apparels. We'll continue to improve our operation, and we are condent in sustaining the solid growth -- faster growth in general merchandise category.

9 | Will do by strengthing the 1P and 3P business, grow higher-margin advertising and commission revenue faster, and growing the service business.

At the same time, we will further improve our platform ecosystem and strengthen the cooperation between our 1P and 3P to help brands and merchants operate more e ciently. This will also support the continued solid growth in our platform marketplace and advertising and commission revenue. The second growth curve is through strengthening our offine retail network and grow our on-demand retail. We plan to continue to build out our offine retail network, reach more users and strengthen cooperation between our online and o ine business while expanding on-demand retail across categories and improve our omnichannel service capability in order to better meet user shopping needs across di erent shopping scenarios. The third growth curve is our service business. Alongside product sales, service are another important growth driver for JD and is a great t for our business model. We are offering users a wider range of high-quality services, including home cleaning, appliances cleaning, auto maintenance and health care services

10 | JD Retail’s operating margin improvement will come from stronger 1P supply chain and scale, product mix, and high margin service revenues.

JD Retail's operating margin has improved steadily since 2016. In particular, its gross margin reached a record high in the third quarter. JD Retail's long-term margin improvement comes from our continued focus on delivering the best possible user experience, reducing costs and improving e ciency. The key drivers include one -- rst, 1P capabilities. With stronger 1P supply chain capabilities and the scale bene ts, we expect product sales gross margin to improve steadily. Second, upside potential in category and brand. Categories such as supermarkets still have meaningful potential to improve pro tability. In addition, as we further rene product mix, electronics and home appliances category also have room for margin expansion over time. Third, platform ecosystem, as high-margin service revenues such as commissions and advertising revenue grow at a rapid pace, we expect our revenue mix to further optimize, serving as a structural driver for margin expansion.

11 | JD Logistics continued to grow strongly 16% with the reclassification of the food delivery business, margins continued to improve.

Moving to JD Logistics. Its revenue grew by 16.1% YoY to RMB 64 billion in Q3, primarily driven by the incremental contribution from ondemand delivery service. On the profitability front, JD Logistics non-GAAP operating income surged by 49.8% YoY to RMB 1.9 billion, with operating margin expanding by 70bps to 3% despite the negative impact from oil price hikes. The margin expansion reected e ciency-led gross margin improvement and the technological leverage from physical AI and robotics deployment across our logistics network.

Our new business continued to improve operating efficiency. Revenues were RMB 8 billion in Q3. The YoY decline primarily reected the reclassification of on-demand delivery revenues from new business to JD Logistics starting Q1 2026 with a sharper focus on nancial discipline.

12 | Food delivery continued to improve its loss making profitability amid QoQ order volume growth and improved unit economics.

JD Food Delivery remained in loss reduction mode with its loss narrowing by over 50% year-on-year and by a further 7% sequentially while maintaining healthy operation with sequential order volume growth. Its unit economics has improved markedly since launch, driven by refined operations, higher subsidy efficiency and diversified revenue streams. Looking ahead, JD Food delivery will focus more on further improving its unit economics and reducing loss in the coming quarters.

13 | JD Logistics continued to improve across its production lines, covering warehousing, sorting and delivery processes, deployed 89% more automated units, improving sorting node automation rate.

JD Logistics continued to push the boundaries of physical automation. In Q3, JDL unveiled its upgraded MetaBrain + LangzuTech operational matrix. 11 new LangzuTech robots were deployed to handle specialized tasks across 9 production lines, covering warehousing, sorting and delivery processes. Our MetaBrain LLM 3.0 serves as the central intelligent command system, orchestrating multirobot clusters to execute real-time decision-making in complex environments, driving a meaningful lift in frontline operational productivity. Building on this, our active deployment of automated logistics units grew 89% year-on-year as of September, further lifting our key sorting node automation rate.

14 | Jingxi’s revenues 2X and saw improving efficiency, bringing in ⅓ of new users in Q3.

Meanwhile, Jingxi also saw improving efficiency with its revenues doubling year-on-year while narrowing operating loss. Jingxi continued to bring new users to our platform and drive higher user engagement, contributing over 1/3 of our total new users in Q3.

15 | Europe is a large retail market. Joybuy is bringing fast and reliable delivery to Europe and now covers >80 towns and cities in Europe.

Europe represents a large retail market, which offers significant growth opportunity for us. Joybuy continued to see strong momentum with rapid growth in both revenue and user base. We continue to improve the customer experience and operating e ciency laying a strong foundation for our future growth. Our fulfillment, for example, our 2 -- the signature 211 delivery service maintains a very high on-time delivery rate, providing local customers in Europe with fast and reliable delivery. This service now covers more than 80 towns and cities in Europe.

16 | See Joybuy gradually building user mind share in key categories, with purchasing users growing, and buying more often.

Meanwhile, higher order density and better coordination across our fulfillment networks continue to bring down our cost per order. On product selection, Joybuy is gradually building user mind share in key categories such as air conditioners and computers. More brands are recognizing Joybuy's value and deepening their cooperation with us. In terms of users, the number of quarterly active purchasing users continues to grow, while purchase frequency and repeat purchase rates are also improving quarter-on-quarter.

17 | Joybuy saw strong momentum in GMV and user growth as revenues grew 35% QoQ, investments only increase slightly QoQ, loss margins continue to improve.

Turning to our international business. Joybuy sustained strong momentum across key operating metrics, including GMV and user base in Q3 with revenue growing by 35% quarter-on-quarter, while keeping overall investment well on track.

investment in Joybuy increased only slightly Q-on-Q. Its quarterly loss margin continued to improve from the previous quarter with all the expense ratio, including fulfillment and marketing expense ratio all improved sequentially.

18 | CECONOMY acquisition helps to strengthen https://t.co/A4MAdYIOYK’s physical footprint offering internationally, especially in Europe, with over 1,000 stores in 11 markets.

The successful closing of CECONOMY acquisition last week marks an important milestone in our international expansion. As the leading consumer electronics retailer in Europe, CECONOMY operates over 1,000 consumer electronics stores in 11 markets under the MediaMarkt, Saturn and MediaWorld brands. This alliance will drive significant synergies across our combined supplier networks, both in China and European markets. The strategic partnership will bring JD's core strengths, including advanced technology, omnichannel retail expertise and world-class supply chain logistics capabilities into international markets and accelerate our international enterprise footprint.

19 | CECONOMY acquisition will be focused on supply chain, fulfillment, and technology.

On the CECONOMY acquisition, this is an important step in JD's international expansion. The cooperation between Joybuy and CECONOMY is focused on 3 areas: First, supply chain. We'll combine both companies' brand relationship with -- and sourcing strengths to further expand product selection and improve procurement and supply chain e ciency. Second, on fulfillment, we'll explore how JD's ful llment capabilities and warehouse network complement CECONOMY's local retail service network to improve network -- overall network utilization and delivery performance. Third, on the technology front, we'll continue to draw on JD's technology expertise to strengthen CECONOMY's digital capabilities, enhancing operational efficiency and supporting its continued development as a leading European omnichannel retailer

20 | Managed to achieve user growth despite lower marketing spend and disciplined investment.

This quarter's user expansion was primarily anchored by our existing core users and Plus members, reecting our deepening brand loyalty and user stickiness. What makes this trend particularly compelling is that we achieved this user growth alongside a notable year-on-year reduction in the group's marketing spend, propelled by optimized marketing efficiency and disciplined investment in new businesses.

21 | JD’s quarterly active users achieved double digit growth for 12 consecutive quarters and crossed 750m.

Regarding your questions on users. First, JD's quarterly active users have achieved double-digit growth for 12 consecutive quarters and annual active users have exceeded 750 million. Our user base continues to expand. In terms of user acquisitions, core retail has always been JD's most important source of new users. We continue to attract new users with a broader selection, more competitive prices and better service.

22 | Seeing positive trends in user retention, continue to focus on increasing purchase frequency, shop more across multiple categories, and converting high-quality users into Plus members.

Alongside continued user acquisitions, we are also seeing positive trends in user retention. In Q3, JD's existing user base continued to report strong double-digit growth, reecting greater user trust and engagement. Going forward, our priorities are to increase purchase frequency and encourage users to shop across more categories with a particular focus on converting high-quality users into Plus members. In Q3, Plus membership maintained double-digit growth with both membership and ARPU growing faster yearon-year than those of the overall user base…. Looking ahead, we believe JD still has room to expand its user base. Our goal of serving all e-commerce users in China remains unchanged.

23 | In the near-term, expect higher AI-related R&D (not capex) investments, which will weigh on profit margins, but be longer-term more accretive.

We need to proactively invest in R&D for the expansion of the use of AI across our supply chain and daily operations. However, these investments are mainly R&D expenses focused on software applications and do not require large capital expenditures. This allows us to maintain healthy free cash ow while pursuing AI opportunities. Higher R&D expenses may put some pressure on margins in the short term. However, we believe this investment will translate into better operating efficiency and support stronger long-term profitability.

24 | https://t.co/A4MAdYIOYK remains fully committed to long-term improvement in profit margins via numerous economies of scale across platform, logistics, AI, etc. JD Retail high single digit margin.

We remain fully committed to driving long-term structural margin expansion within JD Retail, improving efficiency and financial health in new businesses and investing with discipline in high-return strategic priorities, such as our application-focused AI framework and global expansion to secure our longterm market leadership. We are condent in our ability to navigate evolving macro dynamics, consolidate our market position and create long-term value for our shareholders.

Our long-term goal remains unchanged. We expect JD Retail will achieve a healthy high single-digit margin, and we will continue to improve e ciency across the industry.

➡️ Final Takeaways on https://t.co/A4MAdYIOYK $JD:

Revenue growth continues to reaccelerate as https://t.co/A4MAdYIOYK focuses on strengthening its 1P foothold and expanding into the 3P, general merchandise, supermarket and apparel category. Food delivery continued to narrow losses and is moving in the right direction. Higher margin advertising, 3P, strong operating leverage should drive further profit margin expansion in the years ahead, with faster earnings growth. Its long-term potential remains underappreciated.

1 | Q3 标志着持续稳健的转型，收入增长恢复，盈利能力继续改善。

Q3 标志着我们业务的稳健转型。我们的总收入恢复正增长，盈利能力较上一季度以更快速度扩大。核心 JD Retail 实现了稳健的营收和利润扩张。随着我们坚持不懈地专注于提升供应链效率，毛利率创下新高，同时经营利润率在去年创纪录高基数下保持坚挺。

2 | JD Retail 在电子与家电、日用百货以及市场平台和营销方面均出现广泛加速。

JD Retail 在 Q3 实现了明显的运营和财务改善。我们看到 JD Retail 内所有主要业务线都出现广泛加速，包括电子与家电、日用百货以及市场平台和营销服务。从品类表现来看，电子与家电的收入增长势头较上一季度显著反弹。

3 | 日用百货增长 8%，由超市更快增长、医疗保健和工业品双位数增长带动。时尚和家居用品也出现环比改善。

日用百货收入保持强劲势头，同比增长 8.1% 至人民币 1050 亿元。日用百货的强劲表现由我们超市品类持续健康扩张以及医疗保健和工业品双位数增长推动。与此同时，时尚和家居用品也显示出环比改善。各品类的这种广泛势头表明，我们的增长驱动因素正变得日益多元化且更为均衡。

4 | 增长更快且盈利能力更强的市场平台和营销收入增长 10%，将继续改善利润率。

Q3 服务收入为人民币 760 亿元，同比增长 4.7%。市场平台和营销收入增长 9.6%，主要由广告收入双位数增长推动。

除了推动收入增长外，广告的快速增长也作为我们利润率长期扩张的结构性驱动因素。

5 | JD Retail 毛利率连续 18 个季度扩大，并首次突破 20%。

我们在各品类的成功执行以及平台生态系统的扩展，直接转化为强劲的盈利能力。JD Retail 的毛利率已连续 18 个季度同比提升，并首次突破 20% 门槛。

6 | 外卖业务继续保持强劲，但仍处于亏损状态，盈利能力持续改善。

对于我们的外卖业务，推动运营效率持续提升和减少亏损仍是一项战略要务。第三季度，其运营亏损同比减少超过 50%，同时保持了积极的环比改善势头。

7 | 推出 Dongdong，这款 AI 购物助手在早期显示出强劲势头，并在用户规模、转化率、订单量和 GMV 方面带来可衡量的提升。

首先，在客户需求生成方面。9 月，我们推出了 Dongdong，即我们的下一代 AI 购物助手。它标志着我们的用户体验从传统关键词搜索转向由 AI 驱动、基于意图的问题解决方式的范式转变。Dongdong 无缝集成到我们的主应用中，能够准确解读复杂的消费者意图，并将其直接映射到我们庞大的产品和服务目录。早期势头强劲，在用户规模、转化率、订单量和 GMV 方面带来了可衡量的提升。

8 | 看到通过扩展产品品类和品牌、以优惠价格提供优质产品来满足不同用户需求，从而继续推动 JD Retail 增长的清晰路径。日用百货、超市和服饰领域有相当大的空间。

展望未来，我们看到 JD Retail 持续增长的清晰路径。首先，我们将进一步加强所谓的传统电商。我们将继续扩大品类和品牌选择，提高供应链效率，以优惠价格提供优质产品，并满足不同用户的需求。就我们的电子产品和家电品类而言，我们知道创新可以创造需求，并创造新的产品线和品类。我们也有相当大的市场份额提升空间，尤其是在超市和服饰等日用百货品类。我们将继续改善运营，并且我们有信心维持稳健增长——日用百货品类实现更快增长。

9 | 将通过加强 1P 和 3P 业务、让更高利润率的广告和佣金收入更快增长，以及发展服务业务来实现。

与此同时，我们将进一步完善我们的平台生态系统，并加强 1P 和 3P 之间的合作，帮助品牌和商家更高效地运营。这也将支持我们的平台市场以及广告和佣金收入继续稳健增长。第二条增长曲线是通过加强我们的线下零售网络并发展即时零售。我们计划继续建设我们的线下零售网络，触达更多用户，并加强线上和线下业务之间的合作，同时在各品类扩展即时零售，并提升我们的全渠道服务能力，以便更好地满足用户在不同购物场景下的购物需求。第三条增长曲线是我们的服务业务。除了产品销售，服务也是 JD 的另一个重要增长驱动力，并且非常契合我们的商业模式。我们正在为用户提供更广泛的高质量服务，包括家政清洁、家电清洗、汽车保养和医疗健康服务。

10 | JD Retail 的运营利润率提升将来自更强的 1P 供应链和规模、产品组合，以及高利润率服务收入。

JD Retail 的运营利润率自 2016 年以来稳步提升。尤其是，其毛利率在第三季度达到历史新高。JD Retail 的长期利润率提升来自我们持续专注于提供尽可能最佳的用户体验、降低成本并提高效率。关键驱动因素包括：第一，1P 能力。凭借更强的 1P 供应链能力和规模效益，我们预计商品销售毛利率将稳步提升。第二，品类和品牌方面的上行潜力。超市等品类仍有显著的盈利能力提升潜力。此外，随着我们进一步优化产品组合，电子产品和家电品类的利润率也有望随着时间推移而扩大。第三，平台生态系统。随着佣金和广告收入等高利润率服务收入快速增长，我们预计我们的收入结构将进一步优化，成为利润率扩张的结构性驱动因素。

11 | JD Logistics 在食品配送业务重新分类后继续强劲增长 16%，利润率持续改善。

接下来谈 JD Logistics。第三季度其收入同比增长 16.1%，达到人民币 640 亿元，主要受按需配送服务带来的增量贡献推动。在盈利能力方面，JD Logistics 的非 GAAP 运营收入同比大增 49.8%，达到人民币 19 亿元，尽管受到油价上涨的负面影响，运营利润率仍扩大 70 个基点至 3%。利润率扩张反映了由效率推动的毛利率改善，以及实体 AI 和机器人技术在我们物流网络中的部署所带来的技术杠杆效应。

我们的新业务继续提升运营效率。第三季度收入为人民币 80 亿元。同比下降主要反映了自 2026 年第一季度起，按需配送收入从新业务重新分类至 JD Logistics，同时更加聚焦财务纪律。

12 | Food delivery 在环比订单量增长和单均经济效益改善的情况下，持续改善其亏损盈利状况。

JD Food Delivery 仍处于减亏模式，其亏损同比收窄超过 50%，并环比进一步收窄 7%，同时在订单量环比增长的情况下保持健康运营。自上线以来，在精细化运营、更高的补贴效率和多元化收入来源推动下，其单均经济效益已显著改善。展望未来，JD Food Delivery 将在未来几个季度更加专注于进一步改善其单均经济效益并减少亏损。

13 | JD Logistics 在其各条生产线持续改进，覆盖仓储、分拣和配送流程，部署的自动化单元增加了 89%，提升了分拣节点自动化率。

JD Logistics 持续突破实体自动化的边界。第三季度，JDL 发布了升级后的 MetaBrain + LangzuTech 运营矩阵。11 台新的 LangzuTech 机器人被部署到 9 条生产线，处理涵盖仓储、分拣和配送流程的专项任务。我们的 MetaBrain LLM 3.0 作为中央智能指挥系统，协调多机器人集群在复杂环境中执行实时决策，显著提升了一线运营生产率。在此基础上，截至 9 月，我们主动部署的自动化物流单元同比增长 89%，进一步提升了关键分拣节点的自动化率。

14 | Jingxi 的收入实现 2X，并且效率有所改善，第三季度带来了 ⅓ 的新用户。

与此同时，Jingxi 的效率也有所改善，其收入同比翻倍，同时经营亏损收窄。Jingxi 继续为我们的平台带来新用户，并推动更高的用户参与度，第三季度贡献了我们新增用户总数的 1/3 以上。

15 | 欧洲是一个大型零售市场。Joybuy 正在为欧洲带来快速可靠的配送，目前覆盖欧洲 >80 个城镇和城市。

欧洲代表着一个大型零售市场，为我们提供了显著的增长机会。Joybuy 继续保持强劲势头，收入和用户基础均快速增长。我们持续改善客户体验和运营效率，为未来增长奠定坚实基础。例如在履约方面，我们的 2 -- 标志性的 211 配送服务保持着非常高的准时送达率，为欧洲当地客户提供快速可靠的配送。该服务目前覆盖欧洲 80 多个城镇和城市。

16 | 看到 Joybuy 在关键品类中逐步建立用户心智，购买用户持续增长，且购买频率更高。

与此同时，更高的订单密度以及履约网络之间更好的协同，继续降低我们的单均成本。在商品选择方面，Joybuy 正在空调和电脑等关键品类中逐步建立用户心智。更多品牌正在认可 Joybuy 的价值，并深化与我们的合作。用户方面，季度活跃购买用户数持续增长，同时购买频率和复购率也环比改善。

17 | Joybuy 在 GMV 和用户增长方面势头强劲，收入环比增长 35%，投资仅环比小幅增加，亏损率继续改善。

谈到我们的国际业务。第三季度，Joybuy 在包括 GMV 和用户基础在内的关键运营指标上保持强劲势头，收入环比增长 35%，同时整体投资保持在良好轨道上。

对 Joybuy 的投资仅环比小幅增加。其季度亏损率较上一季度继续改善，包括履约和营销费用率在内的所有费用率均环比改善。

18 | 收购 CECONOMY 有助于加强 JD.com 在国际市场，尤其是欧洲的实体布局，覆盖 11 个市场的 1,000 多家门店。

上周成功完成对 CECONOMY 的收购，标志着我们国际扩张的一个重要里程碑。作为欧洲领先的消费电子零售商，CECONOMY 在 11 个市场以 MediaMarkt、Saturn 和 MediaWorld 品牌运营着 1,000 多家消费电子门店。这一联盟将推动我们合并后的供应商网络在中国和欧洲市场产生显著协同效应。战略合作伙伴关系将把 JD 的核心优势，包括先进技术、全渠道零售专业能力以及世界级供应链物流能力带入国际市场，并加速我们的国际企业布局。

19 | CECONOMY 收购将聚焦于供应链、履约和技术。

关于 CECONOMY 收购，这是 JD 国际扩张的重要一步。Joybuy 与 CECONOMY 的合作聚焦于 3 个领域：首先是供应链。我们将结合两家公司的品牌关系和采购优势，进一步扩大商品选择，并提高采购和供应链效率。其次，在履约方面，我们将探索 JD 的履约能力和仓储网络如何与 CECONOMY 的本地零售服务网络形成互补，以提升网络——整体网络利用率和配送表现。第三，在技术方面，我们将继续借助 JD 的技术专长来加强 CECONOMY 的数字能力，提升运营效率，并支持其作为欧洲领先全渠道零售商的持续发展。

20 | 尽管营销支出降低且投资保持克制，仍成功实现用户增长。

本季度的用户扩张主要由我们现有的核心用户和 Plus 会员支撑，反映出我们的品牌忠诚度和用户黏性不断加深。尤其引人注目的是，在集团营销支出同比显著下降的同时，我们实现了这一用户增长，这得益于营销效率的优化以及对新业务的克制投资。

21 | JD 的季度活跃用户连续 12 个季度实现两位数增长，并突破 7.5 亿。

关于你们有关用户的问题。首先，JD 的季度活跃用户已连续 12 个季度实现两位数增长，年度活跃用户已超过 7.5 亿。我们的用户基础持续扩大。在用户获取方面，核心零售一直是 JD 最重要的新用户来源。我们继续通过更丰富的选择、更具竞争力的价格和更好的服务来吸引新用户。

22 | 用户留存呈现积极趋势，将继续专注于提高购买频次、鼓励用户跨更多品类购物，并将高质量用户转化为 Plus 会员。

在持续获取用户的同时，我们也看到用户留存方面的积极趋势。Q3，JD 的现有用户基础继续录得强劲的两位数增长，反映出用户信任和参与度提升。展望未来，我们的重点是提高购买频次，并鼓励用户跨更多品类购物，尤其关注将高质量用户转化为 Plus 会员。Q3，Plus 会员保持两位数增长，会员数量和 ARPU 的同比增速均快于整体用户基础……展望未来，我们相信 JD 的用户基础仍有扩展空间。我们服务中国所有电商用户的目标保持不变。

23 | 短期内，预计与 AI 相关的研发（不是资本开支）投资会增加，这将拖累利润率，但从更长期来看会更具增厚作用。

我们需要主动投资研发，以扩大 AI 在我们的供应链和日常运营中的应用。不过，这些投资主要是聚焦于软件应用的研发费用，不需要大量资本开支。这使我们能够在追求 AI 机会的同时保持健康的自由现金流。更高的研发费用可能会在短期内给利润率带来一些压力。不过，我们相信这项投资将转化为更好的运营效率，并支持更强劲的长期盈利能力。

24 | JD.com 仍完全致力于通过平台、物流、AI 等方面的诸多规模经济来长期改善利润率。JD Retail 高个位数利润率。

我们仍然完全致力于推动 JD Retail 的长期结构性利润率扩张，提升新业务的效率和财务健康状况，并以有纪律的方式投资于高回报的战略重点，例如我们以应用为重点的 AI 框架和全球扩张，以确保我们的长期市场领导地位。我们有信心应对不断变化的宏观动态，巩固我们的市场地位，并为股东创造长期价值。

我们的长期目标保持不变。我们预计 JD Retail 将实现健康的高个位数利润率，并且我们将继续提升整个行业的效率。

➡️ 关于 JD.com $JD 的最终要点：

随着 JD.com 专注于巩固其 1P 基本盘，并向 3P、综合商品、超市和服装品类扩张，收入增长继续重新加速。外卖业务继续缩小亏损，并正朝着正确方向发展。更高利润率的广告、3P、强劲的经营杠杆应会在未来几年推动利润率进一步扩张，并带来更快的盈利增长。其长期潜力仍被低估。

Road MOPD improves medical accuracy by 5.6–8.8 percentage points over vanilla multi-teacher on-policy distillation in the paper’s high-conflict math and medical settings.

The https://t.co/RKHQ6QzxYO and Nanjing University team asks what happens when specialist teachers train the same student. Even with a separate teacher assigned to each domain, their updates still act on shared student parameters.

Road MOPD lets an auxiliary teacher score the tokens in the student’s own rollouts. Its agreement with the assigned teacher changes how much weight each token receives. At the update level, a gradient projection reduces the component that would work against the auxiliary objective, while retaining a minimum gradient norm.

The gains describe the reported domain pair and experimental setups. The authors’ repository says the implementation is awaiting approval for public release.

Beyond Domain-Routed Supervision: Cross-Teacher Guarding for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

Paper: https://t.co/4DzcdaPXRZ  
Our Report: https://t.co/Mbpo1JzMJd

📬 #PapersAccepted by Jiqizhixin
featured_items.translation_zh:
在论文的高冲突数学和医疗场景中，Road MOPD 相比普通多教师在线策略蒸馏，将医疗准确率提高了 5.6–8.8 个百分点。

JD.com 和南京大学的团队提出了一个问题：当专业教师训练同一个学生时会发生什么。即使每个领域都分配了一个单独的教师，它们的更新仍然会作用于共享的学生参数。

Road MOPD 让一个辅助教师对学生自己 rollout 中的 token 进行评分。它与指定教师的一致性会改变每个 token 获得的权重。在更新层面，梯度投影会减少与辅助目标相冲突的分量，同时保留最小梯度范数。

这些提升描述的是报告中的领域组合和实验设置。作者的代码仓库表示，实现正在等待批准后公开发布。

investment in Joybuy increased only slightly Q-on-Q. Its quarterly loss margin continued to improve from the previous quarter with all the expense ratio, including fulfillment and marketing expense ratio all improved sequentially.

Food delivery continued to narrow losses and is moving in the right direction. Higher margin advertising, 3P, strong operating leverage should drive further profit margin expansion in the years ahead, with faster earnings growth. Its long-term potential remains underappreciated.

本季度的用户扩张主要由我们现有的核心用户和 Plus 会员支撑，反映出我们的品牌忠诚度和用户黏性不断加深。尤其引人注目的是，在集团营销支出同比显著下降的同时，我们实现了这一用户增长，这得益于营销效率的优化以及对新业务的克制投资。

21 | JD 的季度活跃用户连续 12 个季度实现两位数增长，并突破 7.5 亿。

关于你们有关用户的问题。首先，JD 的季度活跃用户已连续 12 个季度实现两位数增长，年度活跃用户已超过 7.5 亿。我们的用户基础持续扩大。在用户获取方面，核心零售一直是 JD 最重要的新用户来源。我们继续通过更丰富的选择、更具竞争力的价格和更好的服务来吸引新用户。

22 | 用户留存呈现积极趋势，将继续专注于提高购买频次、鼓励用户跨更多品类购物，并将高质量用户转化为 Plus 会员。

在持续获取用户的同时，我们也看到用户留存方面的积极趋势。Q3，JD 的现有用户基础继续录得强劲的两位数增长，反映出用户信任和参与度提升。展望未来，我们的重点是提高购买频次，并鼓励用户跨更多品类购物，尤其关注将高质量用户转化为 Plus 会员。Q3，Plus 会员保持两位数增长，会员数量和 ARPU 的同比增速均快于整体用户基础……展望未来，我们相信 JD 的用户基础仍有扩展空间。我们服务中国所有电商用户的目标保持不变。

23 | 短期内，预计与 AI 相关的研发（不是资本开支）投资会增加，这将拖累利润率，但从更长期来看会更具增厚作用。

我们需要主动投资研发，以扩大 AI 在我们的供应链和日常运营中的应用。不过，这些投资主要是聚焦于软件应用的研发费用，不需要大量资本开支。这使我们能够在追求 AI 机会的同时保持健康的自由现金流。更高的研发费用可能会在短期内给利润率带来一些压力。不过，我们相信这项投资将转化为更好的运营效率，并支持更强劲的长期盈利能力。

24 | JD.com 仍完全致力于通过平台、物流、AI 等方面的诸多规模经济来长期改善利润率。JD Retail 高个位数利润率。

我们仍然完全致力于推动 JD Retail 的长期结构性利润率扩张，提升新业务的效率和财务健康状况，并以有纪律的方式投资于高回报的战略重点，例如我们以应用为重点的 AI 框架和全球扩张，以确保我们的长期市场领导地位。我们有信心应对不断变化的宏观动态，巩固我们的市场地位，并为股东创造长期价值。

我们的长期目标保持不变。我们预计 JD Retail 将实现健康的高个位数利润率，并且我们将继续提升整个行业的效率。

➡️ 关于 JD.com $JD 的最终要点：

随着 JD.com 专注于巩固其 1P 基本盘，并向 3P、综合商品、超市和服装品类扩张，收入增长继续重新加速。外卖业务继续缩小亏损，并正朝着正确方向发展。更高利润率的广告、3P、强劲的经营杠杆应会在未来几年推动利润率进一步扩张，并带来更快的盈利增长。其长期潜力仍被低估。

1 | Q3 marked the continued solid turnaround, revenue growth returned and profitability continued to improve.

Q3 marked a solid turnaround for our business. Our total revenues returned to positive growth and profitability expanded at an accelerating pace compared to last quarter. Core JD Retail delivered solid top and bottom line expansion. Gross margin reached a new record as we relentlessly focused on driving supply chain e ciencies while operating margin held firm against last year's record high base.

2 | JD Retail saw broad-based acceleration across electronics and home appliances, general merchandise and marketplace and marketing.

JD Retail achieved clear operational and nancial improvement in Q3. We saw broad-based acceleration across all major business lines within JD Retail, including electronics and home appliances, general merchandise and marketplace and marketing services. Looking at category performance, top-line momentum of electronics and home appliances rebounded meaningfully compared to the previous quarter.

3 | General merchandise grew 8%, led by faster growth in supermarket, double digit growth in health care and industrial products. Fashion and home goods also saw QoQ improvements.

General merchandise revenues sustained strong momentum, up 8.1% year-on-year to RMB 105 billion. The strong performance of general merchandise was driven by the continued healthy expansion of our supermarket category and the double-digit growth of health care and industrial products. Meanwhile, fashion and home goods also showed sequential improvements. Such broad-based momentum across categories demonstrates that our growth drivers are becoming increasingly diversified and well balanced.

4 | Faster growing and more profitable marketplace and marketing revenues, up 10%, will continue to improve profit margins.

Service revenues were RMB 76 billion, up 4.7% YoY in Q3. Marketplace and the marketing revenues were up 9.6%, primarily driven by double-digit growth in advertising revenues.

Beyond fueling top line growth, the rapid growth of advertising also serves as a structural driver of our margin expansion over tim

5 | JD Retail GPM expanded for 18 consecutive quarters and crossed 20% for the first time.

Our successful execution across categories and platform ecosystem expansion translated directly into robust profitability. JD Retail's gross margin expanded year-on-year for 18 consecutive quarters and crossed the 20% threshold for the first time.

6 | Food delivery continue to be strong while still loss making, profitability continues to improve.

For our food delivery, driving sustained operating efficiency gains and loss reduction remains a strategic imperative. It achieved over 50% year-on-year reduction in operating losses in Q3 while maintaining positive sequential momentum.

7 | Launched Dongdong, an AI shopping assistant is showing strong early traction and measurable lift in user scale, conversion rate, order volume and GMV.

First, on customer demand generation. In September, we launched Dongdong, our next-gen AI shopping assistant. It marks a paradigm shift in our user experience from the traditional keyword search to AI-driven intent-based problem solving. Seamlessly integrated into our main app, Dongdong accurately interprets complex consumer intent and maps them directly to our vast catalog of products and services. Early traction has been strong, delivering measurable lift in user scale, conversion rate, order volume and GMV.

8 | See a clear path to continue growing JD Retail by expanding product categories and brands, offer quality products at good prices to meet demands of different users. Sizeable room in general merchandise, supermarket, and apparels.

Looking ahead, we are seeing a clear path to continued growth for JD Retail. First, we will further strengthen our so-called traditional ecommerce. We'll continue to expand our selection of categories and brands, improve supply chain efficiency to offer quality products at good price and meet the demands of different users. In terms of our electronics and home appliance category, we know that innovation can create demand and create a new line of products and categories. We also have sizable room to gain market shares, especially in general merchandise categories such as supermarket and apparels. We'll continue to improve our operation, and we are condent in sustaining the solid growth -- faster growth in general merchandise category.

9 | Will do by strengthing the 1P and 3P business, grow higher-margin advertising and commission revenue faster, and growing the service business.

At the same time, we will further improve our platform ecosystem and strengthen the cooperation between our 1P and 3P to help brands and merchants operate more e ciently. This will also support the continued solid growth in our platform marketplace and advertising and commission revenue. The second growth curve is through strengthening our offine retail network and grow our on-demand retail. We plan to continue to build out our offine retail network, reach more users and strengthen cooperation between our online and o ine business while expanding on-demand retail across categories and improve our omnichannel service capability in order to better meet user shopping needs across di erent shopping scenarios. The third growth curve is our service business. Alongside product sales, service are another important growth driver for JD and is a great t for our business model. We are offering users a wider range of high-quality services, including home cleaning, appliances cleaning, auto maintenance and health care services

10 | JD Retail’s operating margin improvement will come from stronger 1P supply chain and scale, product mix, and high margin service revenues.

JD Retail's operating margin has improved steadily since 2016. In particular, its gross margin reached a record high in the third quarter. JD Retail's long-term margin improvement comes from our continued focus on delivering the best possible user experience, reducing costs and improving e ciency. The key drivers include one -- rst, 1P capabilities. With stronger 1P supply chain capabilities and the scale bene ts, we expect product sales gross margin to improve steadily. Second, upside potential in category and brand. Categories such as supermarkets still have meaningful potential to improve pro tability. In addition, as we further rene product mix, electronics and home appliances category also have room for margin expansion over time. Third, platform ecosystem, as high-margin service revenues such as commissions and advertising revenue grow at a rapid pace, we expect our revenue mix to further optimize, serving as a structural driver for margin expansion.

11 | JD Logistics continued to grow strongly 16% with the reclassification of the food delivery business, margins continued to improve.

Moving to JD Logistics. Its revenue grew by 16.1% YoY to RMB 64 billion in Q3, primarily driven by the incremental contribution from ondemand delivery service. On the profitability front, JD Logistics non-GAAP operating income surged by 49.8% YoY to RMB 1.9 billion, with operating margin expanding by 70bps to 3% despite the negative impact from oil price hikes. The margin expansion reected e ciency-led gross margin improvement and the technological leverage from physical AI and robotics deployment across our logistics network.

Our new business continued to improve operating efficiency. Revenues were RMB 8 billion in Q3. The YoY decline primarily reected the reclassification of on-demand delivery revenues from new business to JD Logistics starting Q1 2026 with a sharper focus on nancial discipline.

12 | Food delivery continued to improve its loss making profitability amid QoQ order volume growth and improved unit economics.

JD Food Delivery remained in loss reduction mode with its loss narrowing by over 50% year-on-year and by a further 7% sequentially while maintaining healthy operation with sequential order volume growth. Its unit economics has improved markedly since launch, driven by refined operations, higher subsidy efficiency and diversified revenue streams. Looking ahead, JD Food delivery will focus more on further improving its unit economics and reducing loss in the coming quarters.

13 | JD Logistics continued to improve across its production lines, covering warehousing, sorting and delivery processes, deployed 89% more automated units, improving sorting node automation rate.

JD Logistics continued to push the boundaries of physical automation. In Q3, JDL unveiled its upgraded MetaBrain + LangzuTech operational matrix. 11 new LangzuTech robots were deployed to handle specialized tasks across 9 production lines, covering warehousing, sorting and delivery processes. Our MetaBrain LLM 3.0 serves as the central intelligent command system, orchestrating multirobot clusters to execute real-time decision-making in complex environments, driving a meaningful lift in frontline operational productivity. Building on this, our active deployment of automated logistics units grew 89% year-on-year as of September, further lifting our key sorting node automation rate.

14 | Jingxi’s revenues 2X and saw improving efficiency, bringing in ⅓ of new users in Q3.

Meanwhile, Jingxi also saw improving efficiency with its revenues doubling year-on-year while narrowing operating loss. Jingxi continued to bring new users to our platform and drive higher user engagement, contributing over 1/3 of our total new users in Q3.

15 | Europe is a large retail market. Joybuy is bringing fast and reliable delivery to Europe and now covers >80 towns and cities in Europe.

Europe represents a large retail market, which offers significant growth opportunity for us. Joybuy continued to see strong momentum with rapid growth in both revenue and user base. We continue to improve the customer experience and operating e ciency laying a strong foundation for our future growth. Our fulfillment, for example, our 2 -- the signature 211 delivery service maintains a very high on-time delivery rate, providing local customers in Europe with fast and reliable delivery. This service now covers more than 80 towns and cities in Europe.

16 | See Joybuy gradually building user mind share in key categories, with purchasing users growing, and buying more often.

Meanwhile, higher order density and better coordination across our fulfillment networks continue to bring down our cost per order. On product selection, Joybuy is gradually building user mind share in key categories such as air conditioners and computers. More brands are recognizing Joybuy's value and deepening their cooperation with us. In terms of users, the number of quarterly active purchasing users continues to grow, while purchase frequency and repeat purchase rates are also improving quarter-on-quarter.

17 | Joybuy saw strong momentum in GMV and user growth as revenues grew 35% QoQ, investments only increase slightly QoQ, loss margins continue to improve.

Turning to our international business. Joybuy sustained strong momentum across key operating metrics, including GMV and user base in Q3 with revenue growing by 35% quarter-on-quarter, while keeping overall investment well on track.

investment in Joybuy increased only slightly Q-on-Q. Its quarterly loss margin continued to improve from the previous quarter with all the expense ratio, including fulfillment and marketing expense ratio all improved sequentially.

18 | CECONOMY acquisition helps to strengthen https://t.co/A4MAdYIOYK’s physical footprint offering internationally, especially in Europe, with over 1,000 stores in 11 markets.

The successful closing of CECONOMY acquisition last week marks an important milestone in our international expansion. As the leading consumer electronics retailer in Europe, CECONOMY operates over 1,000 consumer electronics stores in 11 markets under the MediaMarkt, Saturn and MediaWorld brands. This alliance will drive significant synergies across our combined supplier networks, both in China and European markets. The strategic partnership will bring JD's core strengths, including advanced technology, omnichannel retail expertise and world-class supply chain logistics capabilities into international markets and accelerate our international enterprise footprint.

19 | CECONOMY acquisition will be focused on supply chain, fulfillment, and technology.

On the CECONOMY acquisition, this is an important step in JD's international expansion. The cooperation between Joybuy and CECONOMY is focused on 3 areas: First, supply chain. We'll combine both companies' brand relationship with -- and sourcing strengths to further expand product selection and improve procurement and supply chain e ciency. Second, on fulfillment, we'll explore how JD's ful llment capabilities and warehouse network complement CECONOMY's local retail service network to improve network -- overall network utilization and delivery performance. Third, on the technology front, we'll continue to draw on JD's technology expertise to strengthen CECONOMY's digital capabilities, enhancing operational efficiency and supporting its continued development as a leading European omnichannel retailer

20 | Managed to achieve user growth despite lower marketing spend and disciplined investment.

This quarter's user expansion was primarily anchored by our existing core users and Plus members, reecting our deepening brand loyalty and user stickiness. What makes this trend particularly compelling is that we achieved this user growth alongside a notable year-on-year reduction in the group's marketing spend, propelled by optimized marketing efficiency and disciplined investment in new businesses.

21 | JD’s quarterly active users achieved double digit growth for 12 consecutive quarters and crossed 750m.

Regarding your questions on users. First, JD's quarterly active users have achieved double-digit growth for 12 consecutive quarters and annual active users have exceeded 750 million. Our user base continues to expand. In terms of user acquisitions, core retail has always been JD's most important source of new users. We continue to attract new users with a broader selection, more competitive prices and better service.

22 | Seeing positive trends in user retention, continue to focus on increasing purchase frequency, shop more across multiple categories, and converting high-quality users into Plus members.

Alongside continued user acquisitions, we are also seeing positive trends in user retention. In Q3, JD's existing user base continued to report strong double-digit growth, reecting greater user trust and engagement. Going forward, our priorities are to increase purchase frequency and encourage users to shop across more categories with a particular focus on converting high-quality users into Plus members. In Q3, Plus membership maintained double-digit growth with both membership and ARPU growing faster yearon-year than those of the overall user base…. Looking ahead, we believe JD still has room to expand its user base. Our goal of serving all e-commerce users in China remains unchanged.

23 | In the near-term, expect higher AI-related R&D (not capex) investments, which will weigh on profit margins, but be longer-term more accretive.

We need to proactively invest in R&D for the expansion of the use of AI across our supply chain and daily operations. However, these investments are mainly R&D expenses focused on software applications and do not require large capital expenditures. This allows us to maintain healthy free cash ow while pursuing AI opportunities. Higher R&D expenses may put some pressure on margins in the short term. However, we believe this investment will translate into better operating efficiency and support stronger long-term profitability.

24 | https://t.co/A4MAdYIOYK remains fully committed to long-term improvement in profit margins via numerous economies of scale across platform, logistics, AI, etc. JD Retail high single digit margin.

We remain fully committed to driving long-term structural margin expansion within JD Retail, improving efficiency and financial health in new businesses and investing with discipline in high-return strategic priorities, such as our application-focused AI framework and global expansion to secure our longterm market leadership. We are condent in our ability to navigate evolving macro dynamics, consolidate our market position and create long-term value for our shareholders.

Our long-term goal remains unchanged. We expect JD Retail will achieve a healthy high single-digit margin, and we will continue to improve e ciency across the industry.

➡️ Final Takeaways on https://t.co/A4MAdYIOYK $JD:

Revenue growth continues to reaccelerate as https://t.co/A4MAdYIOYK focuses on strengthening its 1P foothold and expanding into the 3P, general merchandise, supermarket and apparel category. Food delivery continued to narrow losses and is moving in the right direction. Higher margin advertising, 3P, strong operating leverage should drive further profit margin expansion in the years ahead, with faster earnings growth. Its long-term potential remains underappreciated.

investment in Joybuy increased only slightly Q-on-Q. Its quarterly loss margin continued to improve from the previous quarter with all the expense ratio, including fulfillment and marketing expense ratio all improved sequentially.

Revenue growth continues to reaccelerate as JD.com focuses on strengthening its 1P foothold and expanding into the 3P, general merchandise, supermarket and apparel category. Food delivery continued to narrow losses and is moving in the right direction. Higher margin advertising, 3P, strong operating leverage should drive further profit margin expansion in the years ahead, with faster earnings growth. 12 | Food delivery 在环比订单量增长和单均经济效益改善的情况下，持续改善其亏损盈利状况。

13 | JD Logistics 在其各条生产线持续改进，覆盖仓储、分拣和配送流程，部署的自动化单元增加了 89%，提升了分拣节点自动化率。

Road MOPD improves medical accuracy by 5.6–8.8 percentage points over vanilla multi-teacher on-policy distillation in the paper’s high-conflict math and medical settings.

The https://t.co/RKHQ6QzxYO and Nanjing University team asks what happens when specialist teachers train the same student. Even with a separate teacher assigned to each domain, their updates still act on shared student parameters.

Road MOPD lets an auxiliary teacher score the tokens in the student’s own rollouts. Its agreement with the assigned teacher changes how much weight each token receives. At the update level, a gradient projection reduces the component that would work against the auxiliary objective, while retaining a minimum gradient norm.

The gains describe the reported domain pair and experimental setups. The authors’ repository says the implementation is awaiting approval for public release.

lead_post.translation_zh:
在论文的高冲突数学和医疗场景中，Road MOPD 相比普通多教师在线策略蒸馏，将医疗准确率提高了 5.6–8.8 个百分点。

JD.com 和南京大学的团队提出了一个问题：当专业教师训练同一个学生时会发生什么。即使每个领域都分配了一个单独的教师，它们的更新仍然会作用于共享的学生参数。

Road MOPD 让一个辅助教师对学生自己 rollout 中的 token 进行评分。它与指定教师的一致性会改变每个 token 获得的权重。在更新层面，梯度投影会减少与辅助目标相冲突的分量，同时保留最小梯度范数。

这些提升描述的是报告中的领域组合和实验设置。作者的代码仓库表示，实现正在等待批准后公开发布。
